pr.body:
## Summary

Resolve the open moderate Dependabot advisory for transitive runtime dependency `uuid`.

## Tickets

Closes #47

## Changes

- `app/package.json`: pin transitive `uuid` through an npm override to patched version `11.1.1`.
- `app/package-lock.json`: regenerate the resolved dependency graph.

## Test Plan

- `npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` reports 0 vulnerabilities.
- `npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test` passes (10 tests).
pr.title: Remediate vulnerable uuid dependency
